howToPlay: Use long-range attacks to chip away at enemies before activating your Super to transform and engage as an assassin. During your transformation, focus on dealing damage to recover health while utilizing your mobility to maintain pressure. Balance your approach by using your gadgets to either support teammates with healing or control the battlefield.
gears: Equip SPEED to capitalize on the increased mobility during your transformation and GADGET COOLDOWN to deploy your support tools more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive transformation-based combat combined with versatile supportive utility.
